scope: Local San Clemente previews only. Food/drinks in all five menu galleries; people/community material in all five Our Story pages, per owner reply.
rules: No new source photos without owner approval.
Default first slide recorded when a post link has no img_index; do not assume approval for other carousel slides.
Preserve menu wording and prices; historical social captions do not establish current availability.
Keep real source originals. No generated replacement dishes or altered food.
Opt-in Instagram playback if native video is unavailable. No autoplay.
Do not publish or change Santa Ana.
Archive captions give share dates, not photograph dates or current specials. Family portraits are not represented as San Clemente location photos.
